description: Robo overslept! Chick the peep clock wakes him up, and Robo learns to tell time on a clock that starts with only the hour hand. Read o'clock and half past, follow Robo's busy day from 7:00 to bedtime, and fix Robo's half-past mix-up.

youtube.title: Telling Time for Kids! Hour and Half Hour with Robo | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Robo overslept! Chick the peep clock wakes him up, and Robo learns to tell time on a clock that starts with only the hour hand. Read o'clock and half past, follow Robo's busy day from 7:00 to bedtime, and fix Robo's half-past mix-up.
For first graders learning to tell time to the hour and half hour. Make a paper plate clock with a grown-up!

do.text: Shh. Robo is powered down. It's morning!
Whoa! What time is it? I have a busy day!
Let me look at the clock. Hmm. It has only one hand!
Yes! The short hand is the hour hand.
The short hand points right at 7.
So it's 7 o'clock. Chick peeped 7 times!
Now watch the hand move. Slowly, slowly.
Ha! Half a peep for half past!
Now the hand moves on to 8. 8 o'clock!
Fun fact: the hour hand goes around two times every day.
Now our clock gets its long hand!
The long hand is the minute hand.
At o'clock, the long hand points straight up to 12.
Both hands point to 12. It's 12 o'clock!
The digital clock says 12, then two zeros.
Next. What time is it now?
Short hand on 3, long hand on 12. 3 o'clock!
Long hand up, it's o'clock! Arm straight up!
Frog, can you hop the long hand halfway round?
Hop, hop, hop! From 12 down to 6!
Clockwise! Clockwise is the way clock hands turn.
The long hand points down to 6. That's half past!
And look! The short hand moved too. Halfway between 7 and 8.
Half past 7. The digital clock says 7:30.
Half a peep again! I love it!
Let's try another. What time is this?
Long hand on 6. Short hand past 3. Half past 3!
Long hand up, o'clock. Long hand down, half past!
Now, my busy day! Read each clock with me.
What time do I wake up?
Then breakfast. What time is it?
Lunch time. Long hand and short hand together!
Is it time to paint yet?
Half past 3. Yes, Dog! Painting time!
Then dinner time. What does the clock say?
Hmm. The short hand is near 7. So it's half past 7!
Wait. Has the short hand reached 7 yet?
No! It's between 6 and 7. It's still the 6 hour.
So it's half past 6. Oops! Thank you, friends!
At half past, look at the number the short hand just passed.
Tick, tock, half the clock! Long hand up, o'clock.
Clock quiz! Look, think, then say the time.
Short hand on 4, long hand on 12. What time?
Short hand between 9 and 10. Long hand on 6.
Question three. Which clock shows half past 2?
Clock B! Long hand on 6, short hand halfway.
Question four. At 12 o'clock, where are both hands?
Last one. The digital clock says 5:30. Say it another way.
Now it's getting dark. What time is it?
Short hand for the hour. Long hand on 12 or 6.
Tick, tock, half the clock. Good night, friends.
